rv.q: The show’s edge has dulled over the years.
The hilarious Avenue Q tells the timeless story of a recent college graduate trying to find his way in the world.
"Avenue Q the musical" will continue thru August 7th with performances as follows: Fridays 7:30 p.m.

cn.t: This Tony-winning puppet musical blends Sesame Street-style characters with adult themes and profanity, though critics note its once-sharp satirical edge has dulled since its 2004 debut.
